note: Private IPA 676 on the delivered and verified 674. Urgent fix: on iOS 27 beta no RPCS3 game started on 674 (stuck on "Lancement du jeu"). The system shared region fills the 4-64 GiB window where the RPCS3 JIT arena was reserved. RPCS3 Core 905 and the host escrow now continue the search up to the task maximum address, low window first, code and data within reach; the PPU/SPU caches stay valid (no codegen input changed). The same window gives every title the full 448 MiB code arena (Assassin's Creed IV exhausted 256 MiB). Core 905 also ships the complete Metal 4 renderer: textures, exact queries, MSAA, kernels, overlays, the boot program precompile on several workers and the persistent Metal 4 pipeline archive, the last M3 texture paths and the VK iOS ZCULL parity; Metal stays opt-in per title until a first device run. MeloNX Core 677 replaces Core 673 (MeloNX session): pipeline creation never waits for a play-time checkpoint of the main cache (side cache, Core 675) and an evicted GPU buffer is recreated when used again (the IPA 674 Hogwarts abort). No iPhone measurement; no FPS claim.
